projects.title: Rivoli Digital Commerce Platform
projects.description: Vue/Nuxt frontend with NestJS and GraphQL services on Commercetools for a major UAE retail client. Redesigned platform achieved GTmetrix B grade and integrated Tabby, Tamara, and Apple Pay payment gateways.

projects.title: Raena B2B eCommerce Platform
projects.description: Full-stack B2B e-commerce platform simplifying order placement for retailers. Built from scratch with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB to manage complex inventory and delivery workflows.

projects.title: Conde Nast Ads Library
projects.description: Owned the ad delivery library serving Vogue, Wired, AD, and GQ. Led development of Native Recipe and Mosaic Ads components, strengthening Conde Nast's advertising portfolio.

projects.title: eKaushal - National Skill Portal
projects.description: National skill-development and job portal for India's NSDC Govt initiative. Built on Node.js, AngularJS, MongoDB, and Express.js to serve job seekers across the country.

projects.title: News Intelligence Platform
projects.description: AI-powered news aggregation with story clustering, bias analysis, and real-time updates. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL to deliver intelligent content delivery.
